heading: EXT. ROOFTOP FIVES COURT, COPENHAGEN - DUSK

units.text: EXT. ROOFTOP FIVES COURT, COPENHAGEN - DUSK
A tarred roof above a canal.
A white-painted court on the asphalt, four walls of corrugated steel.
Chimney pots and TV aerials ring the horizon.
Down in the water, a barge horn moans.
ASTRID LUNDGAARD, 40s, silver braid, plays barefoot, gloved hand hitting a hard rubber ball.
Across from her, MATEUSZ KRÓL, 30s, shirtless, a tattoo of a swallow across his ribs.
In the corner, with a stopwatch and a radio headset, THANDI MOKOENA, 20s, referee, jots numbers on her palm.
Astrid slams a backhand.

The ball cracks off the steel and Mateusz dives, scrapes his knee, returns it high, and Astrid follows it back with a lunge and a swing, and he counters with a lob that lands in the corner, while Thandi shouts the score into her headset.
Eleven all! Next point takes the set!
units.name: THANDI

units.text: Copy, referee. Broadcast is live. Keep it moving.
units.name: RADIO

units.text: Live. Everything's live. Nothing's alive.
units.name: MATEUSZ

units.text: You're drifting left.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: You always say that.
units.name: MATEUSZ

units.text: Because you always drift.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: They set.
Astrid serves, a vicious spinning shot.
Mateusz reads it, steps in, volleys.
They rally, long, ferocious.
Thandi counts.
Please don't go to twelve.
units.name: THANDI

units.text: Girl, hush. Let us breathe.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: The ball skims the tape and drops.
A held breath.
Astrid and Mateusz stare at where it died.
Point, Lundgaard! Set to Lundgaard!
units.name: THANDI

units.text: Mateusz drops to a knee, panting.
Astrid walks to him, extends a gloved hand.
He takes it.
Down on the canal, the barge horn sounds again, longer this time.
